propositions: Prompt cache writes occur on every plan-review gate call but are never read across calls, despite stable TTL and byte-identical prefixes on same-ticket re-reviews within the window

The marked cache breakpoint sits after pass-specific stance suffixes rather than at the shared plan prefix boundary, preventing within-run cross-pass reads even though three passes deliberately prepend identical leading bytes

Single-chunk leaf review passes (finder, verifiers, prereq-verifier, coach, digest) each make one LLM call with distinct system prompts; the current breakpoint placement creates five separate cache keys per run with zero reuse
The telemetry diagnostic warn_if_cache_ineffective only fires when write==0 AND read==0, making the write-every-call/never-read shape invisible to observability

Each plan review pays ~9.2k premium-rate cache-write tokens for zero benefit; moving the breakpoint to the shared prefix boundary would enable within-run reads and same-ticket TTL re-reads, saving ~5-6k token-equivalents per review
